title: Finite-strain J2 periodic cell with a deterministic multi-void realization
purpose: Freeze one deterministic four-void software-regression contract for the public finite-strain J2 affine-periodic workflow while keeping refinement, distributed execution, restart and external scientific validation as distinct evidence layers.
physics: Three-dimensional finite-strain logarithmic J2 plasticity in a unit periodic cube containing four non-overlapping geometric spherical voids under isochoric macroscopic tension.

execution.command: python tests/multi_void_rve_golden_driver.py --mesh-size 0.16 --increments 2 --output /tmp/agentfem-multi-void.json && AGENTFEM_RUN_MULTI_VOID_RVE_REFINEMENT=1 python -m pytest -q tests/test_multi_void_rve_golden.py -k successive_refinement
execution.evidence: The public model.step provider consumes one deterministic hard-core periodic realization, exact affine-periodic equations, provider-owned quadrature state, complete-cell homogenization and the ordinary SimulationResult lifecycle. A fixed h/L=0.16 reference is separated from the opt-in h/L=0.20, 0.16 and 0.12 successive-refinement certificate. Canonical two-rank and same-rank restart checks pass on the same realization and portable identities.

observables: Full row-major homogenized first-Piola stress normalized by the complete periodic-cell reference volume.
Physical-weighted mean and 95th percentile of accepted integration-point PEEQ.
Meshed solid reference fraction, deterministic realization identity, portable mesh identity and periodic-equation identity.
Periodic pairing, positive deformation Jacobian, Hill--Mandel residual, stored-energy component closure and provider-field availability as invariant gates.
PEEQ 99th percentile and maximum and minimum quadrature J remain mesh-sensitive diagnostics rather than Golden targets.
acceptance: The deterministic realization fingerprint, portable h/L=0.16 mesh identity, scientific-input fingerprint and declared reference stack match before the fixed-stack Golden quantities are compared.
The accepted load factors are exactly 0, 0.5 and 1, all global Newton solves converge, and provider-owned F/P/S/MISES/SENER/ELENER/HARDENER/FP/PEEQ fields reach the SimulationResult.

Periodic pairing remains below 1e-12 L, solved equation mismatch below 1e-10 L, minimum quadrature J above 0.99, maximum Hill--Mandel relative residual below 1e-8 and maximum SENER component-closure error below 1e-12.

The h/L=0.20, 0.16 and 0.12 levels all pass invariant gates; the medium-to-fine relative changes remain below 0.5 percent for macroscopic first-Piola stress, 0.2 percent for PEEQ mean, 1.5 percent for PEEQ P95 and 0.2 percent for meshed solid fraction; finest geometry error remains below 1 percent.
A two-rank rerun preserves the realization, mesh and constraint identities and agrees with serial global and weighted observables within floating-point tolerance.
A midpoint checkpoint followed by restart reproduces the uninterrupted nodal, quadrature, constitutive, macroscopic and increment-history state within the declared restart tolerances.

quantities.name: homogenized_first_piola_stress
quantities.description: Row-major complete-cell-volume average of the accepted first-Piola field on the fixed h/L=0.16 reference mesh.

quantities.name: peeq_mean
quantities.description: Physical-weighted mean accepted integration-point equivalent plastic strain.

quantities.name: peeq_p95
quantities.description: Left-continuous physical-weighted empirical 95th percentile of accepted PEEQ.

quantities.name: solid_reference_fraction
quantities.description: Meshed solid reference volume divided by the complete unit-cell reference volume.

refinement_certificate.wording: Successive-refinement stability under provisional software-promotion limits, not formal asymptotic convergence or a GCI claim.

restart.scope: same-rank midpoint checkpoint and restart on h/L=0.16

scope: One deterministic four-void hard-core periodic realization with stable void identities and no boundary-crossing voids.
Public three-dimensional finite-strain J2 affine-periodic model.step route with provider-owned quadrature state.
Fixed two-increment isochoric macroscopic deformation, physical-weighted integration-point statistics, three-level spatial refinement, two-rank execution and midpoint restart evidence.
limitations: One deterministic realization is a software-regression asset, not a statistically representative porous material or a stochastic RVE-size study.

The fixed h/L=0.16 Golden is a reference-stack regression; the three-level certificate shows successive stability only and does not establish an asymptotic range, an observed-order/GCI uncertainty or an external reference solution.

The fixed-stack, refinement, two-rank and restart evidence was regenerated from clean detached commit 17a2c66; a future release that changes the numerical package tree must rerun the complete evidence set before replacing this provenance.
PEEQ P99 and maximum and minimum local J remain mesh-sensitive diagnostics and are not Golden acceptance quantities.
Hill--Mandel work consistency and recoverable-energy component closure are invariant audits, not a complete plastic-dissipation energy ledger.
The low-order displacement-only tetrahedral route and this internal deterministic regression do not replace an independent externally published finite-strain plasticity benchmark.
